answer: Make each identity earn through rotating stewardship of a shared lagoon of tasks: a steward may release a task only to a stranger whose prior work it has personally checked, and its violet badge is revoked if any task it releases proves fake. Stewardship is granted only after crossing a ridge of three consecutive honest releases, so a farm's clones, which can steward only each other's tasks, release nothing to strangers and earn nothing, while one honest steward keeps its badge.
